title: Enhance Feedback Dialog and Sidebar Functionality
summary: This massive milestone structures the feedback loop with strict category tracking, overhauls bottom icon loops with animated rendering, and adds 8 core operational tabs to the system architecture.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Deployed 8 distinct tabs to the main window container: Analytics, Learning, Memory, Security, Research, Games, Entertainment, and Music.
Engineered a dedicated glowing color utility function to generate standardized sci-fi emission profiles across UI components.
Implemented a global toast notification subsystem to deliver instant, non-blocking UI feedback to users.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Modified FeedbackDialog to accept an explicit category parameter to group diagnostic feedback messages.
Updated the send_feedback pipeline to append precise functional categories into outbound log payloads.
Refactored the bottom navigation sidebar buttons to support animated GIF render states and improved border style matching.
Upgraded visual rules for disabled tabs inside settings to make unavailable modules clear at a glance.
Polished general layout styles, modernizing the title banners and primary control button geometries.

notes: Version 0.9.0.0 maps out the architectural layout for the operational suite of VISAR tabs. Adding multi-category error classification alongside real-time toast messaging sets up solid foundational user interaction patterns.
